description: Grafana config audit — Offline security review of a Grafana grafana.ini (or GF_<SECTION>_<KEY>=value env vars / docker-compose environment lines). Flags the default admin/admin password, the public default secret_key, anonymous access (CRITICAL when org_role is Editor/Admin), open sign-up with auto-assigned roles, disabled brute-force protection, auth.proxy without a whitelist, generic OAuth with no allowed domains/groups, tls_skip_verify_insecure, disable_sanitize_html (stored XSS), unsigned plugins, allow_embedding (clickjacking), insecure cookies on HTTPS, plaintext HTTP on all interfaces, weak min TLS, database TLS off, hardcoded DB/OAuth secrets (never echoed), external snapshots and debug logging. Returns score, A-F grade, PASS/REVIEW/FAIL and line-numbered findings with fixes. Params: text (config; newlines may be sent as a literal backslash-n) or url (raw file or GitHub blob URL) instead of text. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
e.g. [security]
admin_password = admin
[auth.anonymous]
enabled = true
org_role = Editor
[users]
allow_sign_up = true

name: security_grafana_check
